signIn.audience: One sign-in for fleet companies, partner stations and the ZAWED team. Your account opens your own area.

panel.title: Every litre, from the tag to the ledger.
panel.lead: Fleet companies, partner stations and the ZAWED team follow the same fill-ups here, each from their own screen.
panel.description: An example fill-up: the station's POS reads the vehicle's tag, the litres are counted, the amount leaves the company wallet and goes to the station's payable, and a receipt is issued.

pump.title: Checked at the pump
pump.body: The tag, the vehicle's limits and the balance, before any fuel flows.

ledger.title: Posted as it happens
ledger.body: Each fill-up is a balanced ledger entry: the wallet goes down and the station's payable goes up.

approval.title: A second person on every money move
approval.body: Top-ups, station payouts and reversals each wait for another person to approve.
